translation.name: Luda yã takada kũ Bisã yão

content: Asɑ u sĩɑ dee dee Gusunɔ win Yinnin wuswɑɑɔ.
U bũu yɑ̃ku yenu kɑ gungunu kɑ bwɑ̃ɑrokunu kɔsukɑ.
U Yudɑbɑ sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, bu Gusunɔ ben bɑɑbɑbɑn Yinni kɑsuo, kpɑ bu win yiirebu kɑ win woodɑbɑ mɛm nɔɔwɑ.
U bwɑ̃ɑroku kɑ gungunu mi bɑ rɑ bũnu sɑ̃ kpuro kɔsukɑ. Mɑ win bɑndɑ wɑ̃ɑ bɔri yɛndu sɔɔ.
U derɑ bɑ wuu gbɑ̃rɑnugisu seeyɑ. Win bɑndu sɔɔ, tɑbu sɑri. Bɔri yɛndɑ tɑ wɑ̃ɑ, domi Yinni Gusunɔ u derɑ u wɛ̃rɑ.

Asɑ u mɑɑ Yudɑbɑ sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, su wuu si sɔmɛ su si gbɑ̃rɑnu kɑ kɔ̃su yenu toosi kpɑ su sin kɔnnɔsun gɑmbobɑ kɔkɔrɔbɑ doke, domi tem mɛ, mu sɑ̃ɑwɑ bɛsɛgim. Mɛyɑ sɑ Gusunɔ bɛsɛn Yinni kɑsu mɑ u sun wɛ̃rɑbu wɛ̃ beri berikɑ kpuro. Mɑ bɑ kpĩɑ bɑ wuu si sɔnwɑ.

Asɑ u tɑbu kowobu nɔrɔbun subɑ goobɑ wunɔbu (300.000) mɔ Yudɑbɑ sɔɔ be bɑ tɛrɛnu kɑ yɑɑsi mɔ. Bɛnyɑmɛɛbɑ sɔɔ mɑɑ, tɔmbu nɔrɔbun subɑ goobu kɑ wɛnɛ (280.000) be bɑ tɛrɛnu nɛni mɑ bɑ tɛn toobu yɛ̃. Be kpuro bɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ tɑbu durɔ dɑmgibu.
Yerɑ Serɑki, Etiopigii u Yudɑbɑ wɔrim wee. Mɑ u tunumɑ Mɑresɑɔ kɑ win tɑbu kowobu nɔrɔbun subɑ nɔrɔbu (1.000.000), kɑ tɑbu kɛkɛ yi dumi gɑwe goobɑ wunɔbu (300).
Mɑ Asɑ u seemɑ u kɑ nùn yinnɑ wɔwɑ ye bɑ mɔ̀ Sefɑtɑɔ, Mɑresɑn bɔkuɔ.

Mɑ Asɑ u Gusunɔ win Yinni kɑnɑ u nɛɛ, Yinni Gusunɔ, wunɛ turowɑ kɑɑ kpĩ ɑ dɑmgii ǹ kun mɛ dɑm sɑrirugii somiru nɑ. Yen sɔ̃, ɑ nɑ ɑ sun somi. Domi wunɛ sɔɔrɑ sɑ tɑ̃sɑ. Mɛyɑ kɑ wunɛn yĩsirɑ sɑ kɑ tɔn dɑbi teni wɔrim nɑ. Gusunɔ bɛsɛn Yinni, ɑ ku de tɔnu u nɑsɑrɑ wɑ wunɛn wɔllɔ.
Mɑ Yinni Gusunɔ u derɑ Asɑ kɑ Yudɑbɑ bɑ Etiopigibu kɑmiɑ, bɑ duki yɑrinɑ Yudɑbɑn wuswɑɑn di.
Mɑ Asɑ kɑ wigibu bɑ bu nɑɑ girɑ sere Gerɑɔ. Mɑ Etiopigii be, bɑ wɔrukɑ bɑ gu. Domi Yinni Gusunɔ kɑ win tɑbu kowobɑ bɑ Etiopigii be kɑm koosiɑ. Yen dɔmɑ te, Yudɑbɑ bɑ yɑ̃nu gurɑwɑ too.
Asɑ kɑ win tɔmbu bɑ wuu si su wɑ̃ɑ Gerɑɔ wɔri bɑ kɔsukɑ. Mɑ bɑ dukiɑ bɑkɑ gurɑ. Domi sin tɔmbɑ Yinni Gusunɔn bɛrum kuɑ bɑ nɑndɑ.
Bɑ be bɑ yɑɑ sɑbenu kɔ̃sun kuu bekunuginu kɑsukɑ. Mɑ bɑ yɑ̃ɑnu kɑ yooyoosu mwɛɛrɑ dɑbi dɑbinu. Yen biru, bɑ gɔsirɑ bɑ wurɑ Yerusɑlɛmuɔ.
